title: Pack Sync
description: This mod lets you quickly download the server’s texture pack. Press H, click “Download texture pack,” then “Open folder” to access the downloaded file.
body:
This mod allows you to easily download the server’s texture pack directly in-game. After joining a server, simply press H to open a dedicated menu. From there, click the “Download texture pack” button to automatically start downloading the resource pack used on the server.

Once the download is complete, you can press “Open folder” to instantly access the location where the file was saved on your computer. This makes it easy to manage, install, or move the texture pack without needing to search through game directories.

The mod simplifies the entire process of obtaining server resource packs, removing the need for external links or manual setup. It provides a fast and user-friendly way to access and use custom textures shared by servers.
